summary.zh-CN: 图形系统工程师，专注实时渲染、引擎架构、GPU Compute、跨平台图形接口与多媒体系统，并通过可复现实验持续学习神经图形。
summary.en: Graphics systems engineer focused on real-time rendering, engine architecture, GPU compute, cross-platform graphics interfaces, and multimedia systems, while exploring neural graphics through reproducible experiments.

zh-CN: 围绕跨平台 RHI、资源绑定、管线状态和 GPU 同步设计可维护的运行时边界。
参与渲染管线、几何处理和性能分析，以帧时间、带宽和资源生命周期定位瓶颈。
在高分辨率多媒体场景中处理数据移动、线程协作和音视频同步。
en: Designed maintainable runtime boundaries around cross-platform RHI, resource binding, pipeline state, and GPU synchronization.
Worked on rendering pipelines, geometry processing, and performance analysis using frame time, bandwidth, and resource lifetime.
Handled data movement, thread coordination, and A/V synchronization in high-resolution multimedia systems.

zh-CN: 用 Three.js、原生 WebGPU 和 WGSL 将底层图形概念整理成可运行、可降级的公开 Demo。
使用 PyTorch 与 ONNX Runtime Web 学习从图形数据生成、训练到浏览器推理的完整链路。
en: Turned low-level graphics concepts into runnable, fallback-safe public demos with Three.js, raw WebGPU, and WGSL.
Studied the path from graphics-data generation to training and browser inference with PyTorch and ONNX Runtime Web.

zh-CN: Render Graph 与资源生命周期
GPU Compute 与渐进式路径追踪
浏览器神经降噪部署实验
en: GPU compute and progressive path tracing
